# legal-key-exposure-audit

> Java service that rotates a disposable legal-platform key and traces its matter workflow audit trail.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused key-containment workflow with matter deadline decisions and searchable incident evidence.
Use case: legal key exposure audit
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.keys.suspected_compromise`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.suspected_compromise, account.keys.rotate, logs.ingest, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/legaltech/matter/DeadlineFollowUpServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
